{{Top|leg}}
A '''boarding bay''' was a specialized [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay converted for boarding operations, and typically consisted of docking clamps, a large universal [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]], multiple cutting lasers, and armored [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] positions.
